_comment_: Smoke test for the ArduinoboyMaster role (LSDJ MI.OUT serial-out byte capture).
What works headlessly:
- The role attaches with mode=ArduinoboyMaster and build=arduinoboy (see stderr).
- SameBoySystem.captureSerialOutBit fires for every LSDJ serial-out bit.
- The synthetic Arduinoboy clock in writeAudioSample (SameBoySystem.cpp)
drives external-clock transfers so bytes actually shift.
- When LSDJ DOES write to its serial port the CLI logs raw bytes to
<stem>_serial_sys0.txt and decoded MIDI to <stem>_midi_sys0.txt.
Known limitation (see AGENTS.md "LSDJ Arduinoboy build (aboy)"):
- The aboy v9.3.3 ROM's PROJECT-screen SYNC field stops accepting A+Right
chord events after position 3 (KEYBD). I have not yet found a chord
sequence that reliably advances past KEYBD; the discovery script
(examples/scripts/lsdj_aboy_sync_discovery.json) DOES advance through
all values, so it's something about the absolute timing of subsequent
chord events. As a result this script lands on KEYBD, not MI.OUT.
Pragmatic verification path:
- cli-lsdj-aboy-sync-discovery confirms the SYNC cycle empirically.
- cli-lsdj-arduinoboy-master (this script) proves the serial-out capture
+ synthetic-clock path: LSDJ in KEYBD mode polls the serial port (PS/2
keyboard reception) and the CLI captures 150k+ raw bytes plus the
transient 0xFA emitted on initial mode change.
- True MI.OUT-mode end-to-end verification needs a savestate fixture
that's pre-configured to MI.OUT (future work).
